title: EEG-PRIME: Prototype-Aligned Representation Learning with Multi-Level Conditioning for EEG Decoding
abstract: arXiv:2608.13072v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Electroencephalography (EEG) decoding models often generalize poorly across datasets and subjects due to domain shifts in acquisition protocols and individual neurophysiology. We propose EEG-PRIME, a two-stage EEG foundation model for cross-dataset multi-task decoding. EEG-PRIME combines masked pretraining with prototype-aligned instruction tuning to enable instruction-aware and subject-invariant decoding across diverse BCI paradigms. During pretraining, an EEG encoder learns transferable representations through masked reconstruction with frequency-cutoff spectral augmentation. During instruction tuning, EEG-PRIME incorporates task-semantic, dataset-specific, and subject-invariant conditioning. The resulting conditioning signal modulates the Q-Former through Layer-wise Query Modulation, while frozen text embeddings of class labels serve as prototypes for cosine-similarity-based prediction across heterogeneous label spaces. translated_title: EEG-PRIME：基于原型对齐表示学习与多级条件控制的脑电解码方法
translated_abstract: 脑电图（EEG）解码模型常因采集协议和个体神经生理的领域偏移，在不同数据集和受试者间泛化能力差。我们提出EEG-PRIME，一种用于跨数据集多任务解码的两阶段EEG基础模型。EEG-PRIME结合掩码预训练与原型对齐指令微调，以实现跨多种脑机接口（BCI）范式的指令感知和受试者不变解码。在预训练阶段，EEG编码器通过带频率截止频谱增强的掩码重建学习可迁移表示。在指令微调阶段，EEG-PRIME融入任务语义、数据集特定和受试者不变的条件控制。所得条件信号通过层级查询调制调节Q-Former，而冻结的类别标签文本嵌入作为原型，用于跨异构标签空间的余弦相似度预测。实验在...
tldr: 本文提出EEG-PRIME，一种结合掩码预训练和原型对齐指令微调的两阶段脑电解码基础模型，通过多级条件控制实现跨数据集和跨受试者的通用解码。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes EEG-PRIME, a two-stage EEG foundation model combining masked pretraining and prototype-aligned instruction tuning, enabling cross-dataset and cross-subject decoding via multi-level conditioning.
